utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-seventh. Have we all got sound?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, sound's fine. Unlike the heating in the portakabin. It's either the Arctic or a tropical greenhouse.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Which one have you got this morning?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Greenhouse. Came in with a coat on, nearly passed out.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Very glamorous, factory life. Right, let's get going.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Hang on, am I coming through? Teams had the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: You're through. Bit echoey, but we can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Before we start, I finished the repair on the old turbine last night. That's all sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, nice to have that one out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, new stuff. What's the position with the replacement parts?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'll go to the treatment plant to pick up the replacement parts for the line one HPU today. It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's a collection, then, rather than another order?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, just picking the replacement parts up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Callum Reid. Collection today, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Full name. Sounds like I'm in trouble.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Only when she puts the middle name in.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Don't tempt me. What else have we got?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll chase the purchase order for the palletiser. I'll do that Monday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The PO itself, yeah? Not chasing a delivery date?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, the purchase order. That's what I'm chasing today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Haley. Monday for that, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: He gets a nickname, I get the register read out.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Favouritism, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. Right, more seriously, the near miss at the Boiler Safety Relief Valve needs writing up.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll write up the near miss at the Boiler Safety Relief Valve. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the one holding us. Agreed, first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz. You take the write-up, first priority.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep. I'll do that first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Mm. Not something we want half a description of, either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. What else, Marcus?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll book a contractor to look at the desiccant unit by next Tuesday. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, next Tuesday for making the booking, or for them being here?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Making the booking by next Tuesday. I'm not saying they'll be on site that day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, Marcus, that's yours. No rush, booking by next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, that's what I meant.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fair question. Those two dates get muddled quite easily.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One more: the pressure drop on the boiler feed pump. Aisha, can you investigate that, due on Friday? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, no, sorry. I haven't got the capacity to take that on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All right. Doyler, can you take the investigation instead? Same deadline, on Friday, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. I'll investigate the pressure drop on the boiler feed pump, due on Friday. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Cheers. Better than me saying yes and sitting on it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, that's fine. I've got room for that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. That goes to Doyler, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, I talked over the end there. Nothing to add, just saying I heard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No worries. Everyone clear on the order? The near-miss write-up comes first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, clear.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I've got the parts collection today. All good.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything we've missed before we finish?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Nothing else from stores.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Nothing from me.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, I'm good.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All good. Enjoy the tropical portakabin.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, thanks, everyone. Catch you out there.
